scope: new fixed bilingual sources and varied queries before evaluation; no E5/MMR/model/download
query: existing literal topic admission, excluding explicit ownership, ambiguous references and conversation/person/time questions; no new language/intent inference
repeat: whole equal text/quote, current selected source, frozen available speaker ONLY, kind event without task/claim; finite explicit repetition statement saying no new information/actions/commitments; reject extra clauses, numbers, commitments, recipients, beliefs, unknown/edited/report-only source
primary: every matching non-repeat source, including all distinct conditions, terminal statuses/current codes/attributed uncertainty; max8, full coverage, no merging/truth/status/identity changes
mandatory: prior compiled non-repeat selection is retained even outside the new topic; cap8 union/unknown/full budget failure returns exact prior compiler output and counters
admission: whole real compiler context, not candidate recall alone; required/manual lore/profiles and existing transport preserved
evaluation: 96 new cases:64 development/32 holdout; full set/wrong first/control drift/retained substantive baseline separately; all previously viewed corpora are seen, no tuning after new results
integration: only after full-set gain and invariant checks; private comparison option is not a user setting; native synthetic MV3 POST/reload and no DB mutations required
